initialize_model_parallel_groups: initialize model and data parallel groups for a given number of GPUs in a distributed training setup
check_model_parallel_initialized: check if model and data parallel groups have been initialized before proceeding with distributed operations
get_model_parallel_group: get the model parallel group that the current process rank belongs to for communication
get_model_parallel_rank: get the current process rank within the model parallel group for tensor operations
destroy_model_parallel: destroy and reset both model and data parallel groups to allow reinitialization
